author: fromacf
body:
Hi, on April 1,2015 I was spectating in Nebula game. During spectator I was banned for fly hacking about 10-15 seconds after I had joined. I wanted to appeal immediately but found more rage in stupidity. I have come now because I hate still having this server on my list and I can't delete it because my minecraft is glitched. 




Other info:
I have not been banned before.
Minecraft username is fromacf
